role: Declares HealthKitServiceProtocol, the @MainActor abstraction of the HealthKit queries MorningProcessingService, SessionAcceptanceService, ReanalysisService, HRVAnalysisPipeline and SleepBoundaryResolver make (so tests can inject MockHealthKitService); adds default-argument conveniences and the HealthKitManager conformance bridge.
types: HealthKitServiceProtocol: protocol — the HealthKit queries dispatched through it (sleep, nap minutes, RR and HR sleep estimates, daytime resting HR, training load, recovery vitals, session export)
HealthKitServiceProtocol: extension — default-argument conveniences and nap default 0
toplevel: HealthKitManager declares conformance (bottom of file). Protocol also requires the nonisolated property isHealthKitAvailable. Authorization, sleep observers, trends, exports and dashboard queries are not requirements; callers use HealthKitManager directly.

units.does: Protocol requirement fetchSleepData(for:recordingEnd:rrPoints:autoSleepExtension:rrStart:): resolves sleep for a recording window, optionally validated by RR, with an auto-sleep extension envelope, and with rrStart (when the strap recording the beats started, for a search range wider than the recording; nil = recordingStart).
units.entry: Protocol requirement; witnesses: HealthKitManager (concrete, HealthKitManager+SleepQueryForwarding.swift), MockHealthKitService. Dispatched through the protocol by the extension conveniences in this file, used by SessionAcceptanceService, MorningProcessingService, ReanalysisService and SleepBoundaryResolver.

units.does: Protocol requirement fetchDaytimeNapMinutes(nightAnchoredAt:): returns qualifying nap minutes for the waking day before the night.
units.entry: Protocol requirement; witnesses: HealthKitManager (concrete), MockHealthKitService. Dispatched via protocol by MorningProcessingService+Sleep.swift and +Merging.swift; HealthKitManager+SleepQueryForwarding.swift is the real witness, mock uses the default 0.

units.does: Protocol requirement fetchDaytimeRestingHR(for:): returns daytime resting HR.
units.entry: Protocol requirement; witnesses: HealthKitManager (concrete), MockHealthKitService. Dispatched via protocol by HRVAnalysisPipeline+Metrics.swift.

units.does: Protocol requirement calculateTrainingLoad(relativeTo:): returns TrainingLoad anchored at referenceDate.
units.entry: Protocol requirement; witnesses: HealthKitManager (concrete), MockHealthKitService. Dispatched via protocol by SessionAcceptanceService.swift, ReanalysisService.swift, ReanalysisService+Sleep.swift; HealthKitManager witness is the bridge at HealthKitServiceProtocol.swift.

units.does: Protocol requirement fetchRecoveryVitals(relativeTo:): respiratory rate, SpO2, temperature for a date.
units.entry: Protocol requirement; witnesses: HealthKitManager (concrete), MockHealthKitService. Dispatched via protocol by MorningProcessingService.swift, +Merging.swift, SessionAcceptanceService.swift.

units.does: Protocol requirement estimateSleepFromHealthKitHR(windowStart:windowEnd:minimumSamples:minimumSleepMinutes:): estimates sleep from background HR samples.
units.entry: Protocol requirement; witnesses: HealthKitManager (concrete), MockHealthKitService (EmuquTests/Mocks/MockHealthKitService.swift, returns nil). Dispatched via the 2-arg convenience (HealthKitServiceProtocol.swift, minimumSamples 12, minimumSleepMinutes 120) by MorningProcessingService+Sleep.swift.

units.does: Requirement (async): sleep boundaries inferred from the strap's RR series (the fallback when HealthKit has no sleep). Implemented by the protocol-extension default, which runs off the main actor; a mock may override.
Protocol requirement exportSessionMetrics(from:): writes SDNN/HR/resting HR/sleep to Apple Health.
units.entry: Protocol requirement; witnesses: HealthKitManager (concrete), MockHealthKitService. Dispatched via protocol by SessionAcceptanceService.swift.

units.does: Default nap credit of 0 minutes for conformers without nap support (MockHealthKitService); HealthKitManager provides the real witness.
units.entry: Default witness used when the conformer (MockHealthKitService) does not implement fetchDaytimeNapMinutes.

units.does: Convenience: fetchSleepData with rrPoints, autoSleepExtension and rrStart nil.
units.entry: Called by SleepBoundaryResolver.swift through the protocol.

units.does: Convenience: fetchSleepData with given rrPoints, autoSleepExtension nil and rrStart nil.
units.entry: Called through the protocol by SessionAcceptanceService.swift, MorningProcessingService+Sleep.swift, +Merging.swift, ReanalysisService+Sleep.swift.

units.does: Convenience for a search range wider than the recording: fetchSleepData(for: searchStart, recordingEnd, rrPoints, autoSleepExtension nil, rrStart) so RR offsets count from the beats' own start.
Convenience: fetchSleepData with the given rrPoints and autoSleepExtension and rrStart nil.
units.entry: The four-argument form for callers holding the protocol type; no app code calls it with an AutoSleep extension at present.

units.does: Convenience: calculateTrainingLoad(relativeTo: Date()). RRCollector+Streaming.swift calls calculateTrainingLoad() on concrete HealthKitManager, which resolves either to this or to HealthKitManager's all-defaults overload; both yield 7 days, forMorningReading true, now.
Default implementation: HealthKitManager.estimateSleepFromHR(rrPoints:recordingStart:) (pure, no manager state) on a detached user-initiated task, awaited; it walks every beat of the night.
Convenience: estimateSleepFromHealthKitHR with minimumSamples 12 and minimumSleepMinutes 120.
units.entry: Called through the protocol by MorningProcessingService+Sleep.swift.

units.does: HealthKitManager witness for calculateTrainingLoad(relativeTo:): calls calculateTrainingLoad(days: 7, forMorningReading: true, relativeTo:).
